Manager, Group Reporting

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role


As we expand our portfolio of AI factories, GPU clusters, and supporting infrastructure, we are hiring a Manager – Group Reporting to join the team.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role, and a genuine opportunity for an entrepreneurial accountant to build something meaningful. You'll be the trusted voice on group financial information, the person execs call when they need to understand true profitability across entities and clusters, the person investors rely on for accurate consolidated numbers, and the leader building a world-class reporting function from the ground up. You'll scale the growing Group Reporting team and drive processes that keep pace with rapid business expansion. If you're an ambitious accountant who thrives in fast-moving environments and wants to be a core part of building Radiant's financial infrastructure, this is your role.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the consolidated financial reporting engine from the ground up, designing processes and systems that will scale with Radiant. Enable the exec team and board to make rapid capital allocation decisions with confidence in the numbers.

  • Lead month-end and year-end close cycles that keep pace with rapid growth, consolidating entities across multiple jurisdictions while maintaining audit-ready quality.

  • Own IFRS consolidation and intercompany accounting, eliminating the noise so leadership sees true group profitability and liquidity position.

  • Collaborate across engineering, HR, operations, and marketing teams -translating financial data into insights that inform business decisions and ensuring finance is a true partner in building cohesive company communication.

  • Manage the audit relationship as the exec team's partner, ensuring external auditors have confidence in our controls and processes.

  • Build and develop the growing Group Reporting team, creating a high-performing function that scales with the business. You'll hire, train, and develop finance professionals, setting the tone for excellence and building a culture where people want to grow their careers.

  • Partner across finance and operations to understand the business drivers behind the numbers, becoming a strategic advisor not just a reporter.

  • Support strategic decision-making by translating complex multi-entity transactions into clear financial data and metrics.

  • Drive continuous improvement, building world-class, controls driven processes that champion AI-driven reporting tools and automation to increase speed, accuracy, and scalability as we grow.

What You'll Bring

  • Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA/CPA or equivalent) with 5+ years of experience in financial reporting, with at least 2 years in IFRS consolidation or group financial reporting.

  • Strong technical skills withdvanced Excel, PowerPoint for reporting, and ability to transition to enterprise accounting software.

  • Clear understanding of complex accounting areas, particularly IFRS 16 lease accounting and revenue recognition under IFRS 15, you can navigate non-standard transactions and help business teams understand accounting implications before deals are done.

  • Strong collaborator who can translate between business and accounting, explaining finance to non-finance teams in clear language.

  • Excellent stakeholder management - building relationships with business leaders, external auditors, and finance teams to ensure complex transactions are properly reflected in consolidated statements.

  • Commercial acumen to understand lease negotiations, revenue terms, and deal structures - and helping inform strategic decisions while ensuring accounting reflects business reality.

  • Meticulous attention to detail combined with an entrepreneurial drive to build better, more efficient processes.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience with enterprise accounting software migrations and system implementations.

  • Experience with IFRS 9 derivatives and hedging.

  • Exposure to energy, infrastructure, or capital-intensive businesses.

What Success Looks Like

Month-end close is a smooth, predictable rhythm; your team owns the calendar, not the other way around.

Leadership trusts our consolidated numbers completely, they reference your reports in board meetings and investor calls with confidence

Execs proactively involve you in strategic decisions because they know you understand the financial implications, your insights help shape how Radiant deploys capital

Why Join Radiant

  • Competitive compensation including company-wide share scheme, bonus and travel paid

  • Work on a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure business at the forefront of the industry

  • Get broad exposure to financial operations, AR/AP, close processes, entity setup, audit - developing well-rounded accounting skills

  • Be part of a team where you're genuinely valued and your work directly enables business decisions

  • Develop your career in a Brookfield-backed company with resources, mentorship, and genuine growth opportunities
